A month takes out at most what the pile holds plus what comes in that month, and what comes in (emissions, or the typical token's inflow standing in for an unknown one) is at most what the reserve outside the pile still holds, so no curve buys back or burns more tokens than exist. It never reads above the room left to the max supply, 100 x (max supply - the pile) / the pile: a month's inflow times 12 can name more tokens than exist, and the pile cannot grow past its max supply.
